name: Lacrosse Scoreboard
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Live, recent, and upcoming NCAA men's and women's lacrosse games with real-time scores and schedules

api_requirements.name: ESPN API
api_requirements.description: ESPN public API for NCAA lacrosse scores and schedules
api_requirements.rate_limit: No official rate limit, but please use responsibly

versions.notes: Fix event start times rendering in UTC. The plugin looked for the LEDMatrix global timezone only on cache_manager.config_manager; on cores that expose config_manager via the plugin manager instead, that lookup found nothing and every start time was drawn in UTC even though the clock plugin was correct on the same device. Timezone resolution now checks the plugin override, then both config managers, then the host system zone, before falling back to UTC. Adds a documented timezone setting under Advanced Settings -- previously the key was not in the config schema, so hand-editing it had no effect.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed. Also enables the NCAA Men's league block by default so a fresh install shows games immediately (matching the other scoreboards).

Add display_durations.non_favorite_live per league: give live games without a favorite team a shorter on-screen turn than your favorites. Applies only when favorite teams are set and favorite_teams_only is off; defaults to 0 (off) for unchanged behavior.

Add exclude_teams (hide specific teams from the live rotation and recent/final scores — spoiler protection, takes precedence over favorite_teams/show_all_live) and favorite_live_boost (tune how many more turns your favorite's live game gets in the rotation vs other live games, 1 = even rotation, default 2).
